# TALRIVO

- [Gaming Headset USB: Audio or Lighting Only?](https://talrivo.com/insights/gaming-headset-usb-audio-or-lighting/): Configuration guide covering USB audio, 3.5mm audio with USB lighting power, CTIA headset plugs, separately priced splitters and sample test plans. No device-specific test or universal compatibility claims.

> TALRIVO represents our own audio manufacturing business in China. Primary product lines are gaming headsets, Bluetooth headphones and TWS earbuds for importers, distributors and private-label brands, with sample preparation, OEM/ODM requirements and production follow-up handled by the TALRIVO team.

TALRIVO presents supplied product images, model details, buyer guides, sample preparation, customization options, RFQ guidance, and official contact routes. Treat gaming headsets, Bluetooth over-ear headphones and TWS earbuds as the three primary product lines. Type-C earphones are a secondary reference category. Product specifications and commercial details are model- and version-dependent.

Do not infer prices, certifications, latency figures, factory size, employee count, production statistics, reviews, ratings, return rates, or market availability. Confirm these details for the selected model and destination market before citing them.

Official website: https://talrivo.com/

Official inquiry email: sales@talrivo.com
Official WhatsApp quick-question route: available from the Contact, Sample Request and RFQ Guide pages.

## Core Pages

- [TALRIVO Home](https://talrivo.com/): Direct category entry for gaming headsets, Bluetooth headphones and TWS earbuds, followed by model images, sample review, private-label sourcing, custom branding, packaging inquiries and RFQ routes.
- [Gaming Headset Manufacturer: OEM and Private Label](https://talrivo.com/gaming-headsets/): TALRIVO represents our own audio manufacturing business in China. Compare wired, 2.4GHz wireless and tri-mode gaming headsets, product demonstrations and model details. An explicitly illustrative selection example connects a private-label brief with connection choice, fabric cushions, accessory checks, sample approval and packaging; it is not a customer case. Workshop-photo references support buyer review questions, not certification or performance claims.
- [Gaming Headset Model Code Index](https://talrivo.com/gaming-headset-models/): White-hat model-code directory for G926, G935, G936, G938, G940, G941, G946 and G947, linking buyers from a model-code search to real TALRIVO product pages, sample review checks and RFQ preparation without claiming third-party brand replacement or original-manufacturer identity.
- [Gaming Headset Sample & Quality Review](https://talrivo.com/gaming-headset-quality-review/): Supplied G935 assembly video with click-to-load YouTube playback and a dedicated assembly watch-page link, workshop photos with full-size image links, a model-specific sample-check table and a document-review checklist. Footage shows selected headband, bracket, earcup, finishing and handoff stages, not a complete manufacturing, packing or test record. Wired versus wireless version must be confirmed separately. Photos are not proof of factory ownership, capacity, certification or test results. Original CE/RED verification SIT240719190301 and RoHS certificate SIT240719190302R are now available with full previews and unchanged PDFs. Both name Nanrui Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. and carry the original July 31, 2024 date; the listed family is PHX-WPRO, G938, G939, G926, G927, G922 and G923. These documents do not name TALRIVO as the holder or establish coverage of all current versions or unlisted models.
- [Private Label Wireless Gaming Headsets](https://talrivo.com/wireless-gaming-headsets/): TALRIVO represents our own audio manufacturing business in China. Product-first collection for importers, distributors and audio brands, with direct customization-scope and selected assembly-video references. Compare six models and the listed connection, driver, battery, lights-off playback, charging and detachable-microphone specifications of G936, G938, G941 and G935. Confirm receiver and target-device compatibility, sample configuration, logo, color, packaging and destination-market documents before RFQ. Buyer FAQ covers how to request project-specific MOQ and lead time without assuming published commercial terms.
- [Wired Gaming Headset Manufacturer: RGB Models](https://talrivo.com/wired-gaming-headsets/): Compare wired RGB gaming headsets, microphone designs, samples, custom logos and retail packaging for your brand. G942 and the wired G935 version are the featured starting points. A connection table distinguishes 3.5mm CTIA audio plus USB lighting from USB audio; confirm availability by model. Includes connector illustration and blank sample-checklist links, optional splitter cost boundaries and model-specific sample inquiries. Wireless and tri-mode products are linked separately, not listed as wired-only equivalents.
- [Wireless Gaming Headset Comparison for OEM Buyers](https://talrivo.com/product-comparison/): Requirement-led shortlist for tri-mode connection, RGB styling, fabric cushions and receiver-based wireless use. Compare listed specifications for G938, G941, G936 and G935 by connection, driver, battery and lights-off playback. One static table reflows into labeled model rows on mobile, preserving the same figures and model links. Listed figures are not controlled comparison-test results; wired G935 is a separate version.
- [Insights](https://talrivo.com/insights/): TALRIVO buyer guides, product evidence articles, and product video references. The #buyer-worksheets section links directly to three ungated blank English worksheets for microphone recordings, packing contents and wireless headset sample reviews, with source instructions and no completed-test or approval claims.
- [Contact TALRIVO](https://talrivo.com/contact/): Official inquiry form, email route and WhatsApp quick-question path for gaming headset, Bluetooth headphone and TWS earbud samples, RFQs, model comparison, OEM/private-label, packaging and product document questions; optional fields can add market, buyer type, channel, quantity stage and timing context, while lighter first questions can start through WhatsApp or a short message.

Options require selected-model confirmation; engineering changes require separate feasibility review and written scope. ## High-Intent Gaming Headset Guides

TALRIVO represents our own audio manufacturing business in China. Links to selected G935 assembly footage, the G938 receiver demo, a blank review sheet, customization scope and original CE/RED and RoHS references. G935 wired/wireless versions are separate; the G938 demonstration is not a G935 test. G936 is not listed in those two certificates. Legal project identity, configuration and destination-market requirements still need confirmation.
